segments.name: Agency and Insurance Services
segments.description: Katalyx's four agencies distribute specialty property and casualty insurance in the E&S marketplace, supported by three technology, marketplace and claims service businesses.
segments.evidence: The Agency and Insurance Services segment comprises the Katalyx platform focused on underwriting, growth and distribution of insurance products, and providing technology and claim services to policyholders and agents.

segments.name: Belmont Insurance Companies - Core
segments.description: Insurance company operations for ongoing direct insurance and assumed reinsurance products written in the excess and surplus lines marketplace.
segments.evidence: Belmont Insurance Companies - Core ("Belmont Core") - insurance company operations for ongoing direct insurance and assumed reinsurance products written in the E&S marketplace (formerly the Penn-America segment).

segments.name: Belmont Insurance Companies - Non-Core
segments.description: Insurance company operations for lines of business that have been de-emphasized or are no longer being written.
segments.evidence: Belmont Insurance Companies - Non-Core ("Belmont Non-Core") - insurance company operations for lines of business that have been de-emphasized or are no longer being written (formerly the Non-Core Operations segment).

revenueModel.text: The Company earns premiums from policyholders for specialty property and casualty insurance distributed through wholesale general agents, retail agents and direct-to-consumer channels, and pays commissions to those agents.
revenueModel.evidence: Contracts with each agent set forth key terms including direct commissions and profit commissions.

changes.text: In the first quarter of 2025, the Company realigned its reportable segments into Agency and Insurance Services, Belmont Core and Belmont Non-Core.
changes.evidence: In the first quarter of 2025, the Company realigned its reportable segments to reflect changes in how the Company now manages its operations, reviews operating results, and allocates resources.

changes.text: In December 2024, the Company completed an internal reorganization establishing Katalyx Holdings LLC as a distinct intermediary platform.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, the Company completed an internal reorganization that established Katalyx Holdings LLC as a distinct intermediary platform.
